text:
anya: Uploaded a new checkpoint bundle for zephyr-lite-3b. Objects are in s3://redwood-artifacts/ingest/zephyr-lite/2026-03-17/weights/ — includes safetensors shards + tokenizer (mergeset_v4.json). Quick note: tokenizer has a nonstandard 0x00 mapping that made one of our eval prompts merge incorrectly.
matt: Thanks — quick Qs: 1) TP layout? TP2/TP4? 2) dtype (fp16/bf16)? 3) any checksums so infra can run the ingest validation?
anya: TP layout is TP2 with interleaved shard splitting (not contiguous). We used fp16 for model weights. During conversion the final layer norm weights were emitted as float32 for two shards — I forced them to fp16 in the post-conversion pass (see command below). Manifest includes sha256 per file.
ravi: Can you paste the manifest snippet and the conversion command? I'll add the validation step to the packaging CI.
anya: Pasted manifest header and the convert command:
```json
{
  "model": "zephyr-lite-3b",
  "shard_count": 8,
  "tp_layout": "TP2-interleaved",
  "dtype": "fp16",
  "tokenizer": "mergeset_v4.json",
  "files": [
    {"path": "shard-0000.safetensors", "sha256": "3b9f..."},
    {"path": "shard-0001.safetensors", "sha256": "a1c2..."}
  ]
}
```
Conversion command I ran:
```
python tools/convert_checkpoint.py \
  --input /mnt/convert/zephyr-raw/ \
  --out s3://redwood-artifacts/ingest/zephyr-lite/2026-03-17/weights/ \
  --format safetensors \
  --force-fp16 \
  --tp-split interleaved \
  --shards 8
```
matt: Perfect. Two asks for CI: a) verify that total param bytes across shards match expected model size (so no missing tensors), and b) run a tokenizer roundtrip check on a small set to catch the 0x00 mapping issue. I'll add both checks to the ingest job.
anya: Added a small prompt set to the repo under tests/tokenizer-roundtrip/ that reproduces the merge issue — note payloads include "\u0000" tokens. Also added a small shim to the conversion: `scripts/fix_dtype.py` that coerces stray float32 tensors back to fp16.
sophia: For serving readiness: do we have kv-cache ordering consistent with our runtime? The runtime expects interleaved KV layout when TP2 interleaving is used.
ravi: Good catch. Anya, does the serializer include a kv_order tag in the metadata? If not, we'll fail the deploy to Dedicated.
anya: I added metadata key `kv_order: interleaved_tp2` at top-level of the manifest. Also included `tokenizer_hash` so we can detect mismatches. Example metadata block in manifest attached above.
artifacts-bot: artifact verification started for s3://redwood-artifacts/ingest/zephyr-lite/2026-03-17/weights/
artifacts-bot: checksum OK for 8/8 files (total size 14.2GB). manifest.json sha256: d4f2... .
ravi: I'll open CR 5432 to add the two CI checks (shard-sum and tokenizer-roundtrip). @matt can you review the CR? pinging for perf/ingest changes.
matt: will review today, aiming to approve by EOD. If any shard size mismatch shows up, CI will block — that's intended.
anya: One more note for oncall: if any serving node reports `kv-cache-mismatch` during warmup, fallback should switch to the TP2-compatible variant (we'll publish a variant tag `zephyr-lite-3b-tp2-fallback`). Added rollout policy in the console: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback on latency reg.
sophia: copying this into the onboarding checklist. Thanks @anya — lgtm on the metadata additions.
ravi: ack :thumbsup:
matt: Thanks team. I'll post the CR link in this thread once created.
summary: coord on ingest, tokenizer quirk, tp layout, dtype, ci checks
